classifications.rationale: The President presently grants the named permittees legal permission to construct, operate, and maintain the international railway tunnel; the authorization occurs through this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: I hereby grant permission to Permittees

classifications.rationale: The permit itself presently subjects the permittees’ facilities and operations to binding permit conditions, while reserving future termination or amendment authority.
classifications.evidence: The United States facilities and operations herein described shall be subject to all the conditions, provisions, and requirements of this permit

classifications.rationale: The permit presently imposes binding duties on the permittees concerning substantial changes and conformity of construction, operation, and maintenance; approval would occur before any substantial change.
classifications.evidence: Permittees shall make no substantial change in the location of the United States facilities or in the operation authorized by this permit until such changes shall have been approved

classifications.rationale: The permit presently imposes inspection, access, compliance, restoration, expense, and other binding conditions on the permittees, including consequences triggered upon later termination or noncompliance.
classifications.evidence: The Permittees shall allow duly authorized officers and employees of such agencies free and unrestricted access to said facilities

classifications.rationale: The permit itself establishes continuing permit status and presently binding rights and duties concerning possession, compensation, notice, maintenance, indemnification, authorizations, and reporting, some exercisable upon stated future contingencies.
classifications.evidence: This permit shall continue in force and effect so long as the Permittees shall continue the operations hereby authorized
